UploadSafetyAlwaysReject.description: When true, reject every image upload without running any checks.

UploadSafetyFailClosed.description: When true, reject image uploads if a check is unavailable (service unreachable or invalid response). When false, allow those uploads (fail open).

UploadSafetyDebug.description: When true, upload success and rejection UI (and the UploadSafety log group) include check scores and failure details.

UploadSafetyTimeout.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for check services.

UploadSafetyNsfwClassifierUrl.description: Hugging Face image-classification endpoint (POST JSON {inputs: base64, parameters: {top_k: 2}}).

UploadSafetyNsfwClassifierApiKey.description: Optional Bearer token sent as Authorization to the NSFW classifier. Leave empty for a local nsfw_detector with no auth.

UploadSafetyNsfwThreshold.description: Reject the upload when the Falconsai `nsfw` score is greater than or equal to this value.
